title: Membership and Linked Bookings in the Rating of the Travel Protection Plans
content:
Holding an active traveller club membership changes what a policy of the Travel Protection Plans is
charged: the club tier held on the issue date decides the discount applied to the premium, and the plan's own
rating decides everything else.

## Where the discount acts

A club discount is applied to the rated premium after loadings and before the policy fee, and never to the policy
fee itself. Where the membership lapses between quotation and issue, the discount is lost, because the tier held
at issue is the one that counts.

## Cover bought alongside another booking

The clause "Cover bought alongside an air booking or a vacation package is rated on the same
declared trip cost as that booking, and the two are corrected together where the booking's price
changes." is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which the trip
cost declared on a certificate is corrected where the underwriting desk has approved a correction of
it.

## Membership and a corporate programme together

A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive: a policy bought under a corporate
programme takes the programme's negotiated premium and no club discount on top.

## Points accruing

Club points accrue on the premium actually paid, at the earn rate of the plan held, and never on the policy fee
or on a returned premium.

## Points of judgement

| The situation | The answer |
|---|---|
| The member held a higher tier at quotation and a lower one on the day of issue | The tier held on the issue date decides the discount |
| The membership had lapsed by the issue date | No discount |
| The policy is bought under a corporate programme by a member of the Wanderlane Traveller Club | The programme's negotiated premium, and no club discount on top |
| Premium is later returned on the policy | No points accrue on the returned premium |
